steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator before servicing. Wait 3 minutes after unplugging before measuring SMPS terminals (160 Vdc may remain). R-134a sealed-system precautions apply.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing electrical parts.

steps.title: Enter Test Mode 1
steps.body: Press main PCB test button once — compressor runs continuously with F-FAN and C-FAN (conventional relay, not linear inverter).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press main PCB test button once — compressor runs continuously with F-FAN and C-FAN (conventional relay, not linear inverter).

steps.title: Continue procedure
steps.body: PCB test mode entered. Continue with component-specific checks below.
steps.sourceExcerpt: After §2-17 test mode entry, proceed with OEM component tests.

steps.title: Compressor running?
steps.body: Confirm compressor starts in Test Mode 1 (7-minute delay may apply after recent stop).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Confirm compressor starts in Test Mode 1 (7-minute delay may apply after recent stop).

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Compressor did not start in Test Mode 1.

steps.title: Check relay RY2
steps.body: Power off. Inspect compressor relay RY2 and AC converting relay per load driving circuit §1-4.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Inspect compressor relay RY2 and AC converting relay per load driving circuit §1-4.

steps.title: Replace relay or PCB
steps.oemOutcome: Replace compressor driving relay RY2 or main PCB when relay coil/open fault.

steps.title: Compressor path OK
steps.oemOutcome: Compressor relay drive verified in Test Mode 1.
